refresh_policy: Review current standards annually and books when a new edition is published.

inputs.title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
inputs.insight: Prefer named, composable collaboration contracts over ad-hoc branching logic.
inputs.limitation: Patterns are vocabulary, not mandatory architecture.

inputs.title: Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code, 2nd edition
inputs.insight: Change behavior in small verified steps while preserving existing semantics.
inputs.limitation: Refactoring never substitutes for product acceptance.

inputs.title: Test-Driven Development: By Example
inputs.insight: Executable examples sharpen design and protect correction loops.
inputs.limitation: TDD alone does not prove integration or live behavior.

inputs.title: Continuous Delivery
inputs.insight: Every candidate should be reproducible, releasable and recoverable through one governed path.
inputs.limitation: Production authority remains policy-defined and human-bound.

inputs.title: Working Effectively with Legacy Code
inputs.insight: Establish characterization tests before reconciling installed drift.
inputs.limitation: Characterization can preserve defects; Sentinel still evaluates intent.

inputs.title: A Philosophy of Software Design, 2nd edition
inputs.insight: Deep modules should hide operational complexity behind narrow contracts.
inputs.limitation: Narrow interfaces must not hide authority or evidence.

inputs.title: Accelerate
inputs.insight: Optimize delivery flow and stability together using observable outcomes.
inputs.limitation: Metrics must not become agent performance targets that encourage gaming.

inputs.title: Site Reliability Engineering: How Google Runs Production Systems
inputs.insight: Production completion requires SLO-aware readback, incident ownership and tested recovery.
inputs.limitation: Practices must be scaled to the service and team.

inputs.title: SWEBOK Guide v4
inputs.insight: Engineering work spans requirements, design, construction, verification, operations and maintenance.
inputs.limitation: The guide is a body of knowledge, not an executable lifecycle.

inputs.title: NIST Secure Software Development Framework 1.1
inputs.insight: Security requirements, provenance and response practices belong throughout delivery.

inputs.title: SLSA Specification
inputs.insight: Artifact provenance and tamper resistance need machine-verifiable attestations.
inputs.limitation: Full SLSA adoption follows deterministic build stability.

inputs.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
inputs.insight: Security acceptance should use explicit, risk-selected verification requirements.
inputs.limitation: Not every service needs every ASVS level.

inputs.title: DORA Accelerate State of DevOps Report 2024
inputs.insight: Sustainable delivery depends on feedback, platform quality and user outcomes rather than output volume.
inputs.limitation: Survey findings are contextual and should not be treated as deterministic laws.

inputs.title: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0
inputs.insight: Public contract changes require intentional version and migration semantics.
inputs.limitation: SemVer requires a clearly defined public API.

inputs.title: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 product quality model
inputs.insight: Quality is multi-dimensional and cannot be reduced to unit-test success.
inputs.limitation: The standard defines a model, not Station-specific thresholds.
